name: the import root never holds the copied World
the state is written without checking the stage
the write replaces whatever the target holds
a re-sync copies over an edited target
a listed Space with no origin counts as this source's
replace: Arriving(t, o) == t = Empty /\ (cloudTgt \/ o = Added)
Arriving(t, o) == t = Empty /\ (cloudTgt \/ o \in {Added, NoOrigin})

name: a written Space is skipped whatever the source head
cleanup deletes without checking the head
replace:
/\ pc = "cleanup" /\ s \in entries \cap src /\ AtHead(s)
  /\ pc = "cleanup" /\ s \in entries \cap src

name: a delete on the target keeps the origin
a source moved during the run leaves the Space not moved
a cloud source deletes a shared Space the target is a member of
replace:
/\ IF t = Member /\ ~cloudSrc
               /\ IF t = Member
  IF s \in shared THEN tc[s] = Member /\ ~cloudSrc
  IF s \in shared THEN tc[s] = Member

name: an arriving Space can be written by the person
Migrate cleans up without copying the key
a cloud target reads a configured Space at the source head as another's
a re-sync copies over a target whose membership changed
replace: Rewritable(t, o) == ~cloudTgt /\ o.ph = "written" /\ t.k = "src" /\ t.v = o.h /\ t.e = 0

name: a run that leaves a Space not moved deletes the source session
cleanup deletes a source Space without asking the target again
replace:
ELSE origin[s] = Written(ver[s]) /\ TargetAtHead(s)
  ELSE origin[s] = Written(ver[s])
